race.comment: CAVALLO RED (2) is the one to beat on his strong record at this track and distance, and he looks well placed third-up after coming back from Saturday company. His latest Ascot run was plain, but this shapes much better and he can land the knockout blow third-up. NICKELPLAY (9) is the immediate danger after a first-up third at Ascot, beaten a long neck despite racing keenly and having difficulty getting clear near the 200m. She has been a regular placegetter rather than a winner, but the 3kg claim keeps her right in calculations. POLYVANOVA (6) brings honest recent form, a sound 1400m record and a good history with this jockey, though she now faces a stronger meeting after her Bunbury second. SEVEN CANDLES (1) resumes off two trials and has the back-form to run well, especially with a prior win from one try around 1400m. CENTRE BOND (3) is next best.
